title: Daily Debrief — Monday Nov 2, 2026
html:
Oil cracked, travel flew, and chips kept sinking.

Today the money moved exactly the way our plan leans: out of AI hardware, into travel. SPY finished almost flat, but it's now sitting right on the line we drew Sunday.

The one thing

SPY closed at $752.10, right on our $752 line. Today it tagged the $763.50–767 ceiling and got sold. Until it closes above $767, treat bounces as selling chances, and watch $743–745 below.

Oil fell about 7.5% (WTI near $96) on hopes for new US–Iran diplomacy, which lifted DAL (+4.1%), RCL (+4.5%) and HLT (+2.2%, record close). The AI selloff kept going: AMD −7.5%, SMCI −7.6%, DELL −7.4%, MU −5.8%. Oracle's $20B stock-and-bond raise made investors nervous about how AI spending gets paid for. S&P 500 −0.5%, Nasdaq −1.1%, Dow +0.4%. VIX 21.15, 10-year 4.89%, ISM manufacturing 55.5. After the close, AAPL and PLTR both beat estimates and both fell about 3%.

SPY levels

  • $781.62 — Oct 6 record high
  • $763.50–767 — ceiling (23.6% of Apr–Oct run + 50-day); rejected today at $763.86
  • $752.30 — the line (38.2% + 1.0x 3-point extension). Now $752.10
  • $743–745 — triple confluence (50% Apr–Oct, 23.6% Mar–Oct, 1.382x extension)
  • $734.15 — 61.8%
  • $721–726 — big floor (200-day $726.31 + 78.6% + 38.2% of the Mar–Oct run)

How I read it: sellers defended the ceiling. A close below $743 means defense ($734, then $721–726). A close above $767 would tell me the dip is over. Extension math: A = $781.62 (Oct 6), B = $760.64 (Oct 16), C = $773.36 (Oct 28). 0.5x 762.87 · 0.786x 756.87 · 1.0x 752.38 · 1.382x 744.37 · 1.618x 739.41 · 2.0x 731.40 · 2.382x 723.38 · 2.618x 718.43.

Your names that matter today

  • HLT $364.71 (+2.2%) — READY ON TRIGGER. Record close, just above the $364.50 trigger. Hit $368.49, near the 0.5x extension at $367.50. Next is 0.786x at $385.90. Entry: a second close above $364.50, or a dip to $356–360 that holds. Cancel on a close below $352.
  • DAL $83.42 (+4.1%) — READY ON TRIGGER. Fuel relief. Ceiling at $85.15–85.40 (61.8% + 0.786x). A close above $85.40 opens $87.20–88.10. Invalid below $80.90.
  • RCL $321.07 (+4.5%) — WAIT. +14% in a week, RSI 72, stalled under the 0.786x extension at $326.90. Want a pullback to $307–308.
  • NVDA $202.06 (−1.3%) — WAIT, $200 DECIDES. Back below the 200-day ($204.17). SMH lost its 200-day ($520) and closed at $508.31. A daily close below $200 is the put trigger, targeting $193.90. Reclaiming $205 cancels it. Earnings Nov 17.
  • PLTR $178.34 (≈$172 after hours) — WAIT. Revenue +96% to $2.31B vs $2.17B expected, guidance raised to about $8.53B, stock still −3.4%. Next overlap is $163–165. Let it settle.
  • Also: AAPL beat and fell about 3% after hours to near $327 (50% level). XOM −4% with oil. BA $175.40, still below the $182–185 failed-rally zone.

Lesson of the day: beating estimates isn't enough

Traders bet on a higher "whisper" number. A stock that ran up into earnings has already priced in a beat. PLTR grew 96%, beat by $140M, raised guidance, and still fell 3.4%. Never predict the reaction; trade the chart after it. Let the stock show you which Fib level it respects, then use it for entry and stop.

Plays on deck (Options Playbook)

  1. HLT Dec 18 $380 call — about $760 (Webull mid, delta 0.33). Enter on a second close above $364.50, or a dip to $356–360 that holds. Exit on a close below $352. Target $385.90. Most you can lose: $760.
  2. DAL Dec 18 $85 call — about $440 (delta 0.49). Enter on a close above $85.40. Exit on a close below $80.90, or if oil goes back over $100. Target $87.20–88.10.
  3. NVDA Dec 18 $190 put — about $785 (delta 0.31). Enter only on a daily close below $200. Exit on a close above $205, and always before Nov 17 earnings. Targets $193.90, then $186.80.

Skip this: AMD and SMCI options into earnings, chasing RCL, buying PLTR or AAPL on the gap, new XOM calls, and dip-buying DELL.

Homework

  1. Mark $752.30 and $743–745 on SPY. Which side does Tuesday close on?
  2. Does HLT close above $364.50 a second time?

Question: AMD reports tomorrow night. Say it jumps 8% Wednesday. Before you'd buy a call, what would you want to see on the chart, and where's your stop?

Coming up (Fed Tracker / Federal Reserve)

Tue Nov 3: Midterm Election Day; AMD and Super Micro report after the close. Wed: ADP (65K expected), ISM services (54.8 expected), Qualcomm and Arm. Thu: Airbnb. Fri: October jobs report. Fed funds 3.75–4.00%, about 76% odds of a December hike; the next FOMC meeting is Dec 8–9.
